_comment: flow_magnetomech: magnetomech composite with an editable applied-field profile. Two volume fractions are editable on the Parameters panel -- the polymer and the nanoparticles -- and water is the remainder (1 - their sum), so it is never stored and cannot drift out of sync. Only the nanoparticles are magnetic, so every magnetic term uses phi_nanoparticle alone while the polymer fraction scales the loaded-sample stiffness. See code/magnetomech/ and backend/tasktype/flow_magnetomech/.
